issues.description: The problem statement requires the SealSaloon.orders attribute to be a modifiable List<Meal>, but the provided solution and the template utility (ArrayHelpers) use plain arrays (Meal[]). This creates a cross-artifact type mismatch: students are told to use List in the instructions/UML while the code ecosystem (ArrayHelpers, Stock, and the reference SealSaloon implementation) expects and operates on arrays. This can confuse students about the intended container type and which helpers/APIs to use, and may lead to implementations that don't match the tests or the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the container type consistent across the exercise. Either: (A) Update the problem statement and UML to require Meal[] (or say "an array or other modifiable collection") and document that ArrayHelpers is provided for array manipulation; or (B) Update the template and solution to use List<Meal> everywhere (replace ArrayHelpers usage with standard List operations) and adjust Stock/other code if needed. Ensure the instructions, UML, and example/helper code all consistently reference the same type.
